title: Characteristics of brain glucose metabolism in Parkinson's disease patients with freezing of gait: a study based on 18F-FDG PET imaging and deep learning.
summary: 29 Parkinson patients and 17 healthy controls are studied; PET-derived group/metabolic features are compared across FOG and non-FOG groups.
